name: claudetto
description: Tunes Claude Code for coding at the lowest token cost, through its official extension points only: settings, hooks, skills, and an output style. It patches nothing.

decideProvider.title: Second opinion
decideProvider.description: Use `off` for no decision tool. Use `jev` for Jev, which needs `typesafeApiKey` or `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` in the env and sends the questions to the TypeSafe API. With `jev` and a key, the tool `mcp__claudetto__decide` is registered and Claude calls it for a decision that is its own. An `AskUserQuestion` dialog always reaches the user either way. The default is `jev` because the key is the switch: without one no tool is registered and nothing leaves the machine.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: The key of Jev for the `decideProvider` and `classifierModel` options. Claude Code keeps it in secure storage, not in a settings file. The env variable `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` serves when this is unset.

context7ApiKey.title: Context7 API key
context7ApiKey.description: Optional. The key the `docs` skill's `ctx7` CLI sends to Context7 for higher rate limits. Claude Code keeps it in secure storage, and claudetto passes it to the CLI through the env, never through the context.

cheapSummaryEnabled.title: Cheap compaction summary
cheapSummaryEnabled.description: Use `true` to have claudetto answer a compaction with one bounded call on `claude-haiku-5-5` instead of letting Claude Code summarize on the model the session runs. It is `false` because no measured rows price it yet, and every failure of the call falls back to the compaction of Claude Code.

handoverThresholdTokens.title: Handover size in tokens
handoverThresholdTokens.description: The input tokens of the last response from which a turn's end hands over: claudetto asks a fork of the conversation for a handoff, compacts the conversation to it, and sends the next prompt. Left unset, it is 400000, or half the context window when that is smaller. Claude Code's own compaction stays for a turn that outgrows the window before it ends.

classifierModel.title: Own tool-call classifier model
classifierModel.description: Use `haiku` or `sonnet` to have claudetto judge each tool call that reads or changes more than the read-only tools, in place of the auto mode classifier of Claude Code. It asks Jev first when `typesafeApiKey` or `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` is set, then `claude-haiku-5-5` or `claude-sonnet-5-5`, both at `medium`, and every call is paid. A failed or unclear check denies the call. Its verdict settles the call, so the auto mode classifier of Claude Code does not run on it, and its `allow` skips the permission prompt in every permission mode, because the hook cannot read the mode. It is `off`, which leaves the judging to the auto mode classifier.

confineEnabled.title: Confine Bash writes
confineEnabled.description: Use `true` to run every `Bash` command in an OS sandbox that refuses a write outside the project folder, the temp folders, and the tool caches (`~/.bun`, `~/.cache`): `sandbox-exec` on macOS, `bwrap` on Linux. Reads, the network, and processes stay open, and `.git/hooks` and `.git/config` of the project are read-only. It sets `CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX`, so the permission check, the deny rules, the hooks, and the auto mode classifier judge the command the model wrote. It needs the built-in sandbox `off`. Where `sandbox-exec` or `bwrap` is missing, a `Bash` call is refused with the reason and never runs unconfined. It is `false` because it changes where `Bash` may write.

readGuardEnabled.title: Guard whole reads of heavy files
readGuardEnabled.description: Use `false` to let `Read` take a lock file, a minified or map file, or a file under `node_modules` or another generated folder whole. By default such a read without a `limit` is denied with a hint to pass `offset` and `limit`, to use `rg`, or to use the package command. It adds nothing to the request and `Bash` is untouched. It is `true` because a whole lock file costs far more context than it gives.

missingToolNoticeEnabled.title: Notice of a missing optional tool
missingToolNoticeEnabled.description: Use `false` to turn off the one line that a new session shows when `ast-grep` is not on the `PATH`. The line names the install command for the platform and `/claudetto:setup`, and it is shown once for the pinned version. The check looks up the `PATH` folders with no process and no model call, and the line is never sent to the model. It is `true` because a user who does not know the tool is missing cannot ask for it.

bunRuleEnabled.title: Bun commands in a Bun repo
bunRuleEnabled.description: Use `false` to stop a session that starts in a folder holding both `package.json` and `bun.lock` from adding one short text to the model's context. The text names the `bun` command for running a script, installing, adding, removing, testing, building, formatting, type checking, and linting, and it is added again after `clear` and `compact`. The check looks up the two files with no process and no model call. It is `true` because a plugin `rules/` file never loads, and a model that is not told reaches for `npm`.

maxSubagentStarts.title: Subagent starts per period
maxSubagentStarts.description: The most subagent starts inside the period of `limitPeriodSeconds`. Left unset, it is 12. The most subagents at once is the `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS` variable of Claude Code, set in its `env` setting.

limitPeriodSeconds.title: Period in seconds
limitPeriodSeconds.description: The length of the period that `maxSubagentStarts`, `maxHeavyToolCalls`, and `maxIdenticalFailures` count in. Left unset, it is 600.

maxHeavyToolCalls.title: Tool calls per period at heavy context
maxHeavyToolCalls.description: The most tool calls inside the period while the context is heavy. A call past the cap is held. Left unset, it is 20.

heavyContextTokens.title: Heavy context in tokens
heavyContextTokens.description: The input tokens of the last response from which the context counts as heavy. Left unset, it is 400000.

maxIdenticalFailures.title: Identical failures before a refusal
maxIdenticalFailures.description: How many times the same call fails with the same error before an identical retry is refused. Left unset, it is 3.

maxTestOutputChars.title: Test and build output in characters
maxTestOutputChars.description: The most characters of a `Bash` test, build, lint, or check run that the model reads. A longer output keeps its head, its tail, and its failure lines, and the whole output goes to a file under `.claude/claudetto/output/`. `0` turns the cut off. Left unset, it is 8000, about 2000 tokens: room for the banner, the summary, and a few failures of a run.

hygieneEnabled.title: Session hygiene
hygieneEnabled.description: Use `false` to start no hygiene process at a session start, so claudetto removes no file of its own or of Claude Code. It is `true` because the sweep removes only the temp folders and handoffs that Claude Code never removes, past their age.

handoffCleanupPeriodDays.title: Handoff retention in days
handoffCleanupPeriodDays.description: The age in days from which hygiene removes a handoff, except the newest one that a resume reads. Use 0 to keep every handoff. Left unset, it follows `cleanupPeriodDays`.

sessionTempCleanupPeriodDays.title: Session temp retention in days
sessionTempCleanupPeriodDays.description: The age in days from which hygiene removes the temp folder of a session that is not running. Use 0 to keep them all. Left unset, it follows `cleanupPeriodDays`.

probeCleanupPeriodMinutes.title: Probe folder retention in minutes
probeCleanupPeriodMinutes.description: The age in minutes from which hygiene removes an `fswatch-probe-*` folder of the temp root. Use 0 to keep them all. Left unset, it is 60.
